scenes.narration: Góc phố Hà Nội, tiếng đàn bầu da diết vang lên giữa nhịp sống hối hả.
scenes.narration_en: In Hanoi's busy street corner, a mournful dan bau melody sounds amidst the rush of life.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. A blind Vietnamese man in a simple grey shirt playing a dan Bau under warm golden sunset light at dusk.

scenes.narration: Cô bé hàng ngày lại xuất hiện, ngồi lặng lẽ bên đống rác thu gom giấy.
scenes.narration_en: The little girl appears daily again, sitting quietly beside her paper-collecting pile of trash.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. A poor Vietnamese schoolgirl in a worn blue uniform listening intently to the musician.

scenes.narration: Cô bé hỏi: "Anh có biết mình đang chơi cho ai không?" Tiếng đàn bỗng ngừng lại giữa câu.
scenes.narration_en: "Do you know whom you are playing for?" she asks. The music suddenly stops mid-sentence.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic close-up. Close interaction between the blind musician and the poor schoolgirl under soft evening streetlights.

scenes.narration: 'Tôi chơi cho những người không thể nghe thấy, và cả em,' anh cười vì mù mà vẫn biết cô bé.
scenes.narration_en: "I play for those who cannot hear," he smiles. He knows the girl despite his blindness.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic medium shot. Close-up of hands touching gently; warm lighting highlights their connection in a narrow alleyway.

scenes.narration: 'Thế nên tôi mới chơi.' Nhạc nổi lên, cô bé mỉm cười lần đầu tiên thấy ánh sáng trong mắt người khác.
scenes.narration_en: "That is why I play." Music swells; the girl smiles seeing light in another's eyes for the first time.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic wide shot. The blind man playing passionately while a joyful poor schoolgirl listens under glowing Hanoi streetlights.

scenes.narration: Cô bé bỏ rác, trở thành người chăm sóc cho nhạc công mù mỗi tối trên phố cũ.
scenes.narration_en: The girl discards her trash duties to become the musician's caretaker every evening on the old street.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. Silhouette of a blind man and a caring schoolgirl sitting together playing music under moonlight.
